title: v2.1.92 - Major Update with Bedrock Setup Wizard and Cost Breakdown
description: Added interactive Bedrock setup wizard for AWS authentication, per-model and cache-hit breakdown to /cost for subscription users, forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting, improved Write tool diff computation (60% faster), and numerous bug fixes including tmux subagent spawning issues and terminal compatibility fixes.

title: v2.1.91 - MCP Tool Result Persistence and Plugin Enhancements
description: Added MCP tool result persistence override via _meta annotation (up to 500K chars), disableSkillShellExecution setting, multi-line prompt support in deep links, and plugin executable bin support. Fixed transcript chain breaks on --resume and improved performance with faster stripAnsi on Bun.

title: v0.119.0-alpha.9 - Rust SDK Pre-release
description: Pre-release version of OpenAI Codex Rust SDK with argument comment lint tool and multi-platform binary support (aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu).

title: v0.37.0-preview.1 - Patch Release
description: Patch release for Gemini CLI preview version 0.37.0, cherry-picking fix 64c928f to address issues in the previous preview build.

title: v1.3.38 - VS Code Extension Release
description: Continue VS Code extension v1.3.38 released as pre-release with builds for multiple platforms including alpine-x64, darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-arm64, and linux-armhf architectures.
